description: Map human DDB2 DNA-contacting residues and test whether XPE Ddb-negative mutations K244E/R273H lie on that surface, with DDB1 as comparison
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DNA_RES=set("DA DC DG DT DU DI".split()); LESION=set(["64T","5PY","3DR","TTD","THF"])
def parse(t):
    L=t.splitlines(); i=0; n=len(L)
    while i<n:
        if L[i].startswith("loop_"):
            j=i+1; tags=[]
            while j<n and L[j].lstrip().startswith("_"): tags.append(L[j].strip()); j+=1
            if tags and tags[0].startswith("_atom_site."):
                recs=[]
                while j<n and not L[j].startswith("#") and not L[j].startswith("loop_"):
                    s=L[j].strip()
                    if s: recs.append(s.split())
                    j+=1
                cols=[x.split(".",1)[1] for x in tags]
                return pd.DataFrame([r for r in recs if len(r)==len(cols)],columns=cols)
            i=j
        else: i+=1
def load(p):
    df=parse(requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.cif",timeout=180).text)
    df=df[df.group_PDB.isin(["ATOM","HETATM"])].copy()
    if "pdbx_PDB_model_num" in df: df=df[df.pdbx_PDB_model_num==df.pdbx_PDB_model_num.iloc[0]]
    df=df[(df.type_symbol!="H")&(df.label_comp_id!="HOH")]
    for c in ["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]: df[c]=pd.to_numeric(df[c],errors="coerce")
    df=df.dropna(subset=["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"])
    df["chain"]=df.auth_asym_id; df["comp"]=df.label_comp_id
    df["seq"]=pd.to_numeric(df.auth_seq_id,errors="coerce")
    return df

def contacts(pdb, prot_chain, dna_chains, cutoff=4.5):
    df=load(pdb)
    dna=df[df.chain.isin(dna_chains)]
    g=df[df.chain==prot_chain]
    t=cKDTree(dna[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values)
    d,_=t.query(g[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values,k=1)
    hit=g.assign(d=d)[lambda x:x.d<cutoff]
    per=hit.groupby(["seq","comp"]).d.min().reset_index().sort_values("seq")
    return df, per

# Human DDB2 (Q92466) DNA-contacting residues
res={}
for pdb, pc, dc in [("4E54","B",["F","G"]), ("4E5Z","B",["F","G"]), ("6R8Y","L",["I","J"]), ("6R8Z","L",["I","J"])]:
    _, per = contacts(pdb, pc, dc)
    res[pdb]=set(per.seq.astype(int))
    print(f"{pdb} human DDB2 chain {pc}: {len(per)} residues within 4.5 A of DNA")
    print("   ", ", ".join(f"{r.comp}{int(r.seq)}" for _,r in per.iterrows()))

core = set.intersection(*res.values())
union = set.union(*res.values())
print(f"\nConserved across all 4 human-DDB2 structures: {sorted(core)}")
print(f"Union: {len(union)} residues")

# XPE Ddb- patient mutations in DDB2 (PMID 8798680): K244E, R273H
XPE=[244,273]
df4,_=contacts("4E54","B",["F","G"])
b=df4[df4.chain=="B"]; dna=df4[df4.chain.isin(["F","G"])]
t=cKDTree(dna[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values)
print("\nXPE Ddb- mutation sites in human DDB2, distance to DNA in 4E54:")
for pos in XPE:
    sel=b[b.seq==pos]
    if len(sel)==0: print(f"  residue {pos}: not modelled"); continue
    d,_=t.query(sel[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values,k=1)
    print(f"  {sel.comp.iloc[0]}{pos}: min distance to DNA = {d.min():.2f} A  (contact set membership: {pos in union})")
# control: distance distribution of all DDB2 residues
d_all,_=t.query(b[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values,k=1)
per_res=pd.DataFrame({"seq":b.seq.values,"d":d_all}).groupby("seq").d.min()
print(f"  context: all modelled DDB2 residues median distance to DNA = {per_res.median():.1f} A; "
      f"percentile of K244 = {100*(per_res<per_res.loc[244]).mean():.1f}%, "
      f"R273 = {100*(per_res<per_res.loc[273]).mean():.1f}%")

# Equivalent check: does DDB1 have ANY residue as close as the XPE sites?
a=df4[df4.chain=="A"]
da,_=t.query(a[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values,k=1)
print(f"\nDDB1 (4E54 chain A) closest residue to DNA: {da.min():.2f} A "
      f"(vs K244 {per_res.loc[244]:.2f} A, R273 {per_res.loc[273]:.2f} A)")

# Figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.5))
ax.plot(per_res.index, per_res.values, lw=0.8, color="#2E6FB4", label="human DDB2 (4E54 chain B)")
da_res=pd.DataFrame({"seq":a.seq.values,"d":da}).groupby("seq").d.min()
ax.plot(da_res.index, da_res.values, lw=0.8, color="#B4442E", label="human DDB1 (4E54 chain A)")
ax.axhline(4.5, ls="--", c="grey", lw=1)
for pos,lab in [(244,"K244E"),(273,"R273H")]:
    ax.annotate(lab, xy=(pos, per_res.loc[pos]), xytext=(pos+40, per_res.loc[pos]+9),
                fontsize=9, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=0.8))
ax.set_xlabel("Residue number"); ax.set_ylabel("Minimum distance to DNA (A)")
ax.set_title("Per-residue distance to DNA in PDB 4E54 (human DDB1-DDB2 on AP-site DNA).\n"
             "XPE Ddb-negative patient mutations K244E and R273H sit on the DDB2 DNA face; no DDB1 residue comes close.")
ax.legend(); ax.set_ylim(0, 80)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
